name: allot-key
description: Connect your self-hosted Allot server with an Allot API key and use seven money skills: month start, payday, month end, subscriptions, receipts, spending plan, assets. Every change is a proposal you confirm.

server_url.title: Allot MCP address
server_url.description: Your Allot server's MCP address, e.g. https://allot.example.com/mcp or http://192.168.0.10:15173/mcp (Settings › AI in Allot shows it).

api_key.title: Allot API key
api_key.description: An API key made in Allot under Settings › AI (allot_…). It is kept as a secret.
